notes:
- Background alerts are real now: An optional WorkManager check asks AniList for new events on a schedule - 30 minutes by default, 15 at the fastest - and posts Android notifications that name the person or title involved. AniList has no push stream, so this is periodic checking, not instant delivery.
- Alerts open the row they are about: A title opens its detail sheet, an activity opens its comment thread, a thread opens at the comment, a follow opens the profile, and a message opens the Messages tab. The destination survives the app being closed.
- The notification centre is redesigned: A compact header with an animated unread pill, an Unread filter, and NEW and EARLIER sections split into Today, Yesterday, Earlier this week and Older. Media rows lead with cover art; social rows use an avatar cluster that counts a folded like group.
- Settings keeps the three ideas apart: Inbox preferences shape the cards, background alerts control what Android posts (master switch, eight categories, interval and Check now), and the Android permission card reports the platform state. Background alerts are off until enabled.
- Enabling alerts cannot flood you: The first check establishes a silent baseline. Later checks post only genuinely new ids, remember what they posted so a retry cannot duplicate an alert, and preserve pending events when a request fails or Android is blocking notifications.
